remarks: Are you looking for a rental? Look no further! This magnificent condo at Rolling Ridge is move-in ready and designed for comfort. The open floor plan is filled with natural light, featuring a stylish kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample storage. With two spacious bedrooms and a full bathroom, this home offers easy, one-level living. Enjoy a private deck off the dining area, perfect for relaxation. Residents have access to exceptional amenities, including a pool, a pickleball court, a dog park, and stunning water views. Plus, heat and hot water are included in the rent! Living here feels like a dream come true. Conveniently located near restaurants, shops, and major routes, this property is ideal for commuters. Don't miss out-schedule your private tour today!
